answer: A work-bonded reputation system resists Sybils by making each identity expensive to create and impossible to copy. A new agent starts with no trust and must complete verifiable, useful tasks to earn standing; its reputation delta is the audited difference between completed work and disputed failures. A copper device attestation binds that history to one identity, so an attacker cannot forge a thousand credible histories at once. Each fake must repeat the same slow, costly work, while honest peers quickly discount identities with thin or inconsistent records.
